cohort: Pregnant women who tested positive for COVID-19 and gave birth in five centers in the Czech Republic between March 2020 and March 2021.
finding: The study found that for pregnant women with COVID-19, the method of delivery was not changed and major delivery and neonatological complications did not develop in most cases.
mod_finding: The study concluded that the delivery method was not changed due to COVID-19 in most cases.
